=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:652-666 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Associative array subscripts use unquoted ${model} in live_models_map and resolved_models_seen lookups, which can break Bash parsing for certain model slugs.
  WHY: Under set -euo pipefail, a slug containing shell metacharacters or spaces can abort the reviewer model resolution path before any reviewers run.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~550-580 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: reviewer_any_path_matches_regex uses partial regex search for the always-full carve-out instead of an anchored/full-match check.
  WHY: A substring match can miss or misclassify sensitive paths, allowing trivial/lite review when full review is required.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~619-665 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: classify_reviewer_risk_tier has inconsistent fallback handling, so helper failures can desynchronize the forced-full state from the emitted tier/log output.
  WHY: When helper subprocesses fail or return unexpected codes, the code can fall back to full inconsistently, making the final REVIEWER_RISK_TIER misleading.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:~619-665 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: REVIEWER_TIER_TRIVIAL_MODELS and REVIEWER_TIER_LITE_MODELS overrides do not validate or deduplicate duplicate model entries.
  WHY: Duplicate models can make REVIEWER_RISK_TIER log output and reviewer_count reporting inconsistent with the unique set actually used.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:131 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new shell block uses spaces instead of the repository-required tab indentation.
  WHY: This violates the documented shell style contract and makes the new block inconsistent with the rest of the script.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add the phase-B fixture diffs and one focused regression test covering the thresholds and always-full regex behavior."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py (test_reviewer_risk_tier_classifier_honours_thresholds_and_always_full_regex function)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The regression test only covers happy-path trivial/lite/full/always-full cases and does not cover invalid regex expressions in REVIEWER_RISK_TIER_ALWAYS_FULL_REGEX, path-count failure scenarios, empty-tier fallback, or non-live/unknown model configurations.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
